claims.title: Source-weighted disturbance robustness for common-span endotactic switched inclusions
claims.exact_statement: For a finite family of finite actual exponent-arrow diagrams, each endotactic and all with the same stoichiometric span S, with every rate coefficient in a supplied interval [kappa,K] where 0<kappa<=K<infinity, fix any positive class P=(c+S) intersect R^d_{>0}. Assume the N33 affine-activity witness F_h=min_lambda(r_lambda dot x+b_lambda(h)), H>0, h_P, compact convex plateau K_h, and scale ladder. For every nonneutral active slope r, mode j, let E*_{j,r} be the edges minimizing r dot source among edges with r dot nu nonzero, and Phi_{j,r}(x)=max_{e in E*_{j,r}} x^(source_e); set underlinePhi_r=min_j Phi_{j,r}. Let U(t,x) be a nonempty compact convex multifunction with values in S, measurable in t, upper semicontinuous and locally bounded in x. If, for some 0<=theta<1, every u in U(t,x) obeys r dot u >= -theta*kappa*H*underlinePhi_r(x) for every 0<h<=h_P, x in [h,h^-1]^d, and every active nonneutral slope r of F_h at x, then every maximal absolutely continuous solution of dot x in co(union_j {sum_e a_je*x^(source_je)*nu_je : a_je in [kappa,K]}) + U(t,x) from every x0 in P is global, remains positive, and enters one common compact convex K_P subset P in finite time. K_P and each x0's entry-time bound are independent of rate, mode, mixture, disturbance, and solution selections. A box entry-time bound at scale h is [F_h(c)-min_{x in [h,h^-1]^d}F_h(x)]/[(1-theta)*kappa*H*h^M], where M=max_{j,e}||source_je||_1. There is no entry bound uniform over all x0 in an unbounded P or across different classes.
assumptions: Each mode's actual exponent-arrow diagram is finite and endotactic under the essential-edge definition: for every w, every essential edge at a maximal w-source has w dot nu < 0.
Every mode has exactly the same stoichiometric subspace S; all velocities and disturbances lie in S.
Reaction rates lie in one globally supplied positive interval [kappa,K].

The N33 affine-activity, weighted-source, compact-plateau construction holds for the finite union of mode complexes and this class P; this is internally reconstructed candidate evidence, not externally certified proof.

The disturbance multifunction is nonempty compact convex, t-measurable, upper semicontinuous in state, and locally bounded on the positive orthant; its support satisfies the source-weighted one-sided bound in the exact statement almost everywhere in time.
claims.status: conditional theorem; internally derived differential-inclusion transfer from N33, not externally validated or priority-cleared
claims.proof_path: work/agents/endotactic_geometry_math/FINAL_REPORT.md; N33 source proof: work/agents/systems_metabolism/chemostat_control/astra/endotactic_permanence.tex, especially weighted drift, plateau/absorption, and switching sections
claims.novelty_boundary: Common nonsmooth Lyapunov functions for convexified switching differential inclusions and ISS analysis for differential inclusions with inputs are prior art. This report does not claim either framework as new. The scoped transfer adds a source-tier-specific one-sided disturbance budget to the N33 classwise finite-entry absorber. Literature search did not clear priority for this exact corollary; novelty remains UNKNOWN.

supplied: finite mode diagrams, source/product exponents and reaction vectors
verified endotacticity assumptions and common span S
disturbance support condition relative to the N33 affine witness
not_claimed: cost to recognize endotacticity or verify common span
cost or useful bounds for constructing the N33 affine family, H, h_P, or entry times
rate-history acquisition, bit complexity, or a polynomial-time certificate compiler

claims.falsifier: A finite common-span endotactic mode family and a regular disturbance multifunction satisfying the stated source-weighted support inequality, together with a solution that exits the common plateau, reaches the boundary, fails global continuation, or violates the entry-time bound. A targeted proof audit should prioritize the same-tier maximizer in Phi, the union-complex activity gap, and the finite-minimum chain rule at ties.
claims.next_gate: Independent cold review of the source-tier disturbance estimate and all-solution differential-inclusion continuation; then compare the exact support-envelope condition against prior ISS/robust permanence theorems before making any novelty claim.

counterexamples_to_broader_claims.example: For 0 <-> A with unit inflow/outflow, adding tangent forcing u=-1 gives x'=1-x-1=-x, so x(t)->0.

counterexamples_to_broader_claims.claim_refuted: the union of mode spans is enough for a common classwise absorber
counterexamples_to_broader_claims.example: Switch forever to 0 <-> A in the family {0 <-> A, 0 <-> B}. The union span is R^2, but x_B(t)=x_B(0) can be arbitrarily large.

counterexamples_to_broader_claims.claim_refuted: the lower rate bound can be removed
counterexamples_to_broader_claims.example: For 0 <-> A with inflow 1/(1+t) and outflow 1, x'=1/(1+t)-x and x(t)->0.
